target_subject: an adult man in a decorated dark blue uniform and a boy in a dark blue school-style jacket standing at a wooden table

The adult stands behind the boy, leaning slightly forward; both face downward toward the table surface.

The boy stands with both hands placed flat on the table, head bowed, eyes directed at the open publications before him.
